title: Energy Price Shock
description: Global gas prices have surged 40% this month. Household heating bills are soaring. Opposition is demanding emergency subsidies. Your Finance Minister warns the budget cannot sustain open-ended support.

choices.text: Launch emergency subsidy program (costly)

effects.news: Government launches emergency energy subsidy worth millions. Opposition calls it 'election bribe.'

choices.text: Targeted aid only for the poorest households

effects.news: Government opts for targeted energy support. Middle class angry at being excluded.

choices.text: Reject subsidies — let the market adjust

effects.news: PM refuses energy subsidies. Protests planned. National Front calls it 'betrayal of working families.'

choices.text: Negotiate emergency gas deal with eastern supplier

effects.news: Government signs emergency energy deal. EU officials 'concerned.' Opposition cheers.

title: Minister Corruption Leak
description: An investigative journalist has published recordings allegedly showing your Regional Development Minister discussing diversion of EU infrastructure funds to a party-linked construction firm. The recording quality is unclear but media coverage is massive.

choices.text: Fire the minister immediately and open investigation

effects.news: PM fires Regional Minister over corruption recording. 'We have zero tolerance' says Markova.

choices.text: Defend the minister — call the recording fabricated

effects.news: PM defends minister, claims recording is fake. Opposition demands resignation. Protests outside parliament.

choices.text: Open quiet internal investigation, keep minister for now

effects.news: PM orders internal review of corruption allegations. Opposition: 'fox guarding the henhouse.'

choices.text: Ask prosecutor to investigate independently

effects.news: Prosecutor opens probe into Regional Minister. Government faces difficult weeks ahead.

title: Inflation Hits 10%
description: Monthly inflation data shows prices have risen to double digits for the first time in 15 years. Bread and fuel prices are causing hardship across the country. Your finance team is divided on the response.

choices.text: Wage and price freeze for 3 months

effects.news: Government announces emergency price controls. Business sector furious. IMF 'concerned.'

choices.text: Interest rate hike — coordinate with Central Bank

effects.news: Central Bank raises rates to fight inflation. Mortgage holders face higher payments.

choices.text: Emergency budget: cut spending to reduce demand

effects.news: Emergency austerity measures announced. Public sector unions call general strike.

choices.text: Blame speculators and launch price-gouging investigation

effects.news: PM blames 'profiteers' for inflation. Special task force announced. Economists skeptical.

title: Coalition Partner Issues Ultimatum
description: The Social Democrats are threatening to leave the coalition unless you increase the minimum wage by 25% and reverse planned pension adjustments. Their leader has given you a 2-week deadline.

choices.text: Agree to their demands fully

effects.news: Government accepts Social Democrat wage demands. Business groups warn of economic damage.

choices.text: Offer partial compromise (15% wage increase)

effects.news: Government and Social Democrats reach partial wage deal. Coalition survives — for now.

choices.text: Reject demands — call their bluff

effects.news: PM refuses Social Democrat ultimatum. Coalition in crisis. Early elections possible.

choices.text: Offer them a senior ministerial post instead

effects.news: PM reshuffles cabinet to include Social Democrat in key role. Party congress needed to approve.

title: Protests Erupt in Capital
description: Tens of thousands have taken to the streets in Pustgrad protesting rising living costs and government corruption. The protest is peaceful but growing. Opposition parties are organizing support. Your Interior Minister asks for instructions.

choices.text: Meet with protest leaders, offer dialogue

effects.news: PM agrees to meet protest leaders. Government signals openness to reform demands.

choices.text: Ignore — wait for protests to fade

effects.news: Government stays silent as protests continue. Opposition accuses PM of 'arrogance.'

choices.text: Announce reform package to address grievances

effects.news: PM announces reform program in response to protests. Details vague but tone conciliatory.

choices.text: Accuse foreign agents of funding protests

effects.news: PM claims protests organized by 'foreign-funded NGOs.' EU criticizes 'anti-democratic rhetoric.'

title: EU Rule of Law Warning
description: The European Commission has sent a formal letter warning that Pustinyakovo risks losing EU cohesion funds over concerns about judicial independence and procurement transparency. A response is required within 30 days.

choices.text: Commit to judicial reform roadmap

effects.news: Government pledges judicial reform to EU. Nationalists condemn 'Brussels diktat.'

choices.text: Reject criticism as interference in sovereignty

effects.news: PM rejects EU criticism. Funding freeze possible. National Front cheers 'standing up to Brussels.'

choices.text: Promise reforms but delay implementation

effects.news: Government sends 'reassuring' letter to EU. Commission will monitor progress.

choices.text: Visit Brussels — personal diplomacy mission

effects.news: PM flies to Brussels for talks. Government calls visit 'productive.' Opposition skeptical.

title: Major Factory Closure Announced
description: The Severtsi Steel Plant — employing 4,200 workers in the Northern Industrial region — has announced closure due to energy costs and competition. Workers are blocking the gates. The region's MP is threatening to leave the coalition if nothing is done.

choices.text: Nationalize the factory temporarily

effects.news: Government nationalizes steel plant. Workers celebrate. EU concerned about state aid rules.

choices.text: Emergency subsidies to keep it open 1 year

effects.news: Government offers factory rescue package. Criticism it delays inevitable closure.

choices.text: Allow closure — invest in retraining program

effects.news: Factory closes. Government promises 'retraining.' Workers call it 'abandonment.'

choices.text: Find foreign investor — emergency investment mission

effects.news: PM launches foreign investor search for struggling plant. Timeline uncertain.

title: Hostile Media Campaign Begins
description: A major TV channel — linked to the Citizens' Union — has launched a prime-time series claiming government officials are coordinating with foreign NGOs to 'undermine national identity.' Your media advisor calls it a coordinated disinformation campaign.

choices.text: Launch legal action against the broadcaster

effects.news: Government sues broadcaster over 'disinformation.' Press freedom groups alarmed.

choices.text: Hold press conference — counter with facts

effects.news: PM holds detailed press conference rebutting media claims. Ratings split by party loyalty.

choices.text: Ignore — it will blow over

effects.news: Government silent on media attacks. Opposition campaign gaining momentum.

choices.text: Leak compromising information about media owner

effects.news: Leaked files on TV magnate emerge. Journalists question source. Government denies involvement.

title: Border Incident with Neighbor
description: Armed troops from the neighboring state briefly crossed into the Eastern Border region, claiming a 'navigational error.' Two border guards were briefly detained. The incident has inflamed nationalist sentiment. NATO allies are watching.

choices.text: Diplomatic protest — demand explanation and apology

effects.news: Pustinyakovo files formal diplomatic protest over border incident. Awaiting neighbor's response.

choices.text: Request NATO emergency consultation

effects.news: Pustinyakovo invokes NATO consultation clause. Alliance pledges solidarity. Russia condemns 'escalation.'

choices.text: Escalate — mobilize border forces

effects.news: PM orders border force mobilization. Markets react badly. Military chiefs concerned about escalation.

choices.text: Downplay — accept their explanation quietly

effects.news: Government accepts neighbor's 'navigation error' explanation. Opposition calls it humiliating.

title: Opposition Files No-Confidence Motion
description: The Citizens' Union and National Front have jointly filed a no-confidence motion citing the handling of the energy crisis and corruption allegations. They need only a few more votes to succeed. The vote is in 10 days.

choices.text: Fight the vote — whip coalition MPs hard

effects.news: Government survives no-confidence by 4 votes. Coalition shows cracks. PM calls it 'vindication.'

choices.text: Offer opposition a 'national unity' committee

effects.news: PM offers bipartisan unity deal. Some opposition MPs abstain. Vote fails narrowly.

choices.text: Call early elections preemptively

effects.news: PM dissolves parliament and calls snap elections. Gamble on public verdict.

choices.text: Reshuffle cabinet to shore up support

effects.news: PM reshuffles cabinet ahead of confidence vote. New faces in Finance and Interior.

title: Severe Drought in Southern Fields
description: The worst drought in 20 years is devastating the Southern Fields region. Crops have failed across 40% of farmland. Farmers are demanding emergency compensation. The regional governor wants a disaster declaration.

choices.text: Declare national disaster — full compensation package

effects.news: Government declares agricultural disaster. Farmers get full compensation. Opposition grudgingly approves.

choices.text: Partial aid — access EU agricultural emergency funds

effects.news: Government taps EU funds for drought victims. Farmers say it is 'too little, too late.'

choices.text: Reject compensation — farmers should have insured crops

effects.news: PM rejects drought aid. Farmers blockade highways. Citizens' Union pledges emergency bill.

title: Secret Oligarch Meeting Revealed
description: Photographs show a senior DA figure meeting privately with the country's most powerful oligarch — a man under corruption investigation. The meeting is claimed to be 'private.' Opposition is calling it a smoking gun.

choices.text: Force the official to resign immediately

effects.news: Official resigns after oligarch meeting scandal. PM: 'No one is above accountability.'

choices.text: Claim the meeting was 'accidental'

effects.news: Government says oligarch meeting was 'coincidental.' Journalists publish phone records.

choices.text: Announce anti-oligarchy legislation immediately

effects.news: PM turns scandal into reform moment — announces anti-oligarch transparency law.

title: General Strike Threatened
description: The Confederation of Labor Unions has announced a 48-hour general strike in 2 weeks if the government does not agree to a 20% increase in the minimum wage. 800,000 workers could walk out.

choices.text: Negotiate — offer 15% increase over 2 years

effects.news: Government reaches deal with unions. Strike called off. Business groups warn of 'wage spiral.'

choices.text: Call their bluff — refuse to negotiate under threat

effects.news: Strike goes ahead. Country partially paralyzed. PM seen as 'hardline.' Polls tumble.

choices.text: Offer tax cuts to workers instead of wage rise

effects.news: Government offers alternative to wage rise. Unions split — radical wing rejects, moderates consider.

title: IMF Demands Fiscal Consolidation
description: The IMF has published a country review warning that Pustinyakovo's deficit trajectory is unsustainable. They recommend cutting spending by 3% of GDP or raising taxes. Failure to act could affect credit rating.

choices.text: Accept IMF recommendations — austerity program

effects.news: Government announces austerity measures following IMF pressure. Unions plan protest. Markets rally.

choices.text: Tax wealthy and corporations instead

effects.news: Government chooses tax-the-rich approach over cuts. Business groups threaten capital flight.

choices.text: Reject IMF demands — maintain current course

effects.news: PM rejects IMF demands as 'interference.' Credit rating watch negative. Opposition concerned.

title: MP Defects to National Front
description: A senior DA backbencher has publicly announced he is joining the National Front, citing 'betrayal of traditional values' and 'surrender to Brussels.' He is the third DA MP to defect this year.

choices.text: Publicly condemn defection — draw clear ideological line

effects.news: PM attacks defector as 'opportunist.' DA draws ideological line. NF welcomes new member.

choices.text: Appeal for unity — offer defector return deal

effects.news: PM offers olive branch to defector. Party insiders divided on whether to 'forgive' him.

choices.text: Investigate if NF bribed or blackmailed the MP

effects.news: Government opens probe into NF 'recruitment tactics.' NF calls it 'political persecution.'

title: Major EU Development Funds Approved
description: The European Commission has approved a €450 million infrastructure development package for Pustinyakovo. The funds must be spent on transport, green energy, and digital infrastructure within 5 years.

choices.text: Prioritize roads and railways in underdeveloped regions

effects.news: EU funds to boost Northern and Mountain region infrastructure. Regional mayors praise announcement.

choices.text: Green energy transition — wind and solar

effects.news: Green energy investment package unveiled. GF celebrates. Industry region mayors protest.

choices.text: Capital city digital transformation

effects.news: Digital hub investment for capital announced. Rural regions feel ignored.

title: Health Ministry Pharmaceutical Deal Exposed
description: Documents leaked to media show the Health Ministry paid 3x market price for vaccines from a company linked to a party donor. The deal was signed without competitive tender. Opposition is calling for a parliamentary investigation.

choices.text: Fire Health Minister, announce full audit

effects.news: Health Minister dismissed over vaccine procurement scandal. Opposition: 'too little, too late.'

choices.text: Defend minister — claim deal was legitimate

effects.news: PM defends Health Minister. Poll shows 72% believe deal was corrupt. EU asks for explanation.

choices.text: Let the prosecutor decide — no political interference

effects.news: Government refers vaccine case to prosecutor. Reform groups cautiously optimistic.

title: Ethnic Tensions Rise in Minority Valley
description: A series of incidents between ethnic majority and minority communities in Minority Valley has led to 3 nights of unrest. Local mayor is asking for police reinforcement. Nationalist parties are inflaming rhetoric online.

choices.text: Send police — restore order firmly but fairly

effects.news: Police deployed to Minority Valley. Order restored. Rights groups concerned about tactics.

choices.text: Convene dialogue commission — minority and majority representatives

effects.news: PM convenes ethnic reconciliation talks. National Front calls it 'pandering.' Progress slow.

choices.text: Blame outside agitators — nationalist framing

effects.news: PM blames 'foreign-funded provocateurs' for unrest. EU minority rights monitor dispatched.

title: Investigative Journalist Receives Death Threats
description: The journalist who broke the Regional Minister corruption story has received credible death threats and has temporarily left the country. Press freedom organizations are calling on the government to act. The trail leads to organized crime.

choices.text: Assign police protection — investigate threatening network

effects.news: Government assigns protection to journalist, opens probe into threat network. Press groups cautiously praise.

choices.text: Dismiss — say journalist should have been more careful

effects.news: PM's comments on threatened journalist spark international outrage. EU condemns statement.

choices.text: Use case to push for press freedom legislation

effects.news: PM turns journalist case into press freedom push. Reform groups celebrate. Tabloids furious.

title: Tax Revenue Falls Short
description: Tax collection for the quarter came in 12% below forecast due to economic slowdown. You face a projected budget shortfall of 2.1% of GDP above the EU limit. The Finance Minister presents three options.

choices.text: Emergency spending cuts across all ministries

effects.news: Government announces 10% cuts across ministries. Public sector strikes announced.

choices.text: Temporary tax on financial transactions

effects.news: Financial transaction tax passed. Business lobby angry. IMF 'concerned about precedent.'

choices.text: Borrow — issue government bonds

effects.news: Government issues emergency bonds to cover shortfall. Debt risk rising.

title: Intelligence Chief Accused of Foreign Links
description: An opposition MP has published documents suggesting the head of the State Intelligence Service has been meeting regularly with a foreign embassy without government knowledge. The documents appear authentic.

choices.text: Fire intelligence chief — open investigation

effects.news: Intelligence chief fired over foreign contact allegations. Security vacuum feared by experts.

choices.text: Stand by him — claim meetings were authorized

effects.news: Government defends intelligence chief. Opposition produces second set of documents.

choices.text: Request NATO allies to investigate jointly

effects.news: NATO counter-intelligence team invited for joint review. Seen as sign of confidence in alliance.

title: Internal Leadership Challenge
description: A senior DA figure has announced they will challenge Elena Markova at the party congress in 3 months. The challenger is more conservative and skeptical of the coalition with the Social Democrats.

choices.text: Welcome the challenge — show confidence

effects.news: PM welcomes leadership contest. 'Democracy works inside and outside the party,' she says.

choices.text: Move to secure delegates before congress

effects.news: PM begins delegate consolidation effort. Party congress shaping up as crucial moment.

choices.text: Offer challenger a senior cabinet post to drop bid

effects.news: PM reshuffles cabinet. Challenger suspends leadership bid. 'Unity deal' suspected by press.

title: Referendum on EU Integration Demanded
description: The National Front has gathered 300,000 signatures demanding a referendum on Pustinyakovo's EU membership. Under the constitution, 400,000 signatures trigger mandatory parliamentary debate.

choices.text: Dismiss — petition doesn't meet threshold

effects.news: Government rejects EU referendum petition on procedural grounds. NF: 'democracy under attack.'

choices.text: Hold the referendum — trust the people

effects.news: Referendum on EU membership called. Brussels alarmed. Markets react. Campaign begins.

choices.text: Counter with pro-EU campaign and public debate

effects.news: Government launches pro-EU information campaign in response to referendum demand.

title: Banking Sector Warning
description: The Central Bank has issued a private warning that two mid-sized commercial banks are showing signs of stress. Non-performing loans are at record highs. If news leaks, a bank run could follow.

choices.text: Quietly arrange bank rescue — deposit guarantee

effects.news: Banking sector 'restructuring' announced. Opposition suspects hidden bailout.

choices.text: Be transparent — announce support publicly

effects.news: Government announces bank stability package. Lines form at ATMs briefly but settle. Honesty praised.

choices.text: Allow market resolution — no bailout

effects.news: Bank failure shocks economy. 28,000 depositors affected. Government faces crisis response demands.

title: Green Future Threatens Over Coal Mine
description: Green Future party leader Petko Zdravev has threatened to leave the coalition unless the government halts expansion of the Pernik coal mine, which is also the largest employer in the Mountain Region.

choices.text: Halt the mine expansion

effects.news: Mine expansion halted. GF stays in coalition. Mountain Region workers devastated.

choices.text: Allow mine — offer GF renewable energy project instead

effects.news: Mine proceeds. Government offers GF renewable consolation prize. GF splits internally.

choices.text: Commission independent environmental review

effects.news: Environmental review ordered on coal mine. GF accepts, describes it as 'minimum requirement.'

title: State Infrastructure Cyberattack
description: A sophisticated cyberattack has disrupted government databases, the national electricity grid monitoring system, and the healthcare scheduling system. Intelligence services say the attack originated from foreign servers.

choices.text: Publicly attribute attack — name the foreign actor

effects.news: Government names foreign state behind cyberattack. Diplomatic crisis follows. NATO allies supportive.

choices.text: Handle quietly — patch systems, don't escalate

effects.news: Government confirms 'technical incident' affecting some services. Details vague. Press suspicious.

choices.text: Request NATO cyber defense assistance

effects.news: NATO cyber team deployed to assist Pustinyakovo. Alliance solidarity displayed.

title: Pension System Crisis
description: The Finance Ministry reveals the pension fund will be insolvent within 12 months at current rates. The options are: raise retirement age, cut pension values, increase contributions, or borrow. All options are politically toxic.

choices.text: Gradually raise retirement age by 2 years

effects.news: Retirement age to rise by 2 years. Unions call general strike. Opposition smells blood.

choices.text: Increase worker and employer contributions

effects.news: Pension contribution hike announced. Business lobby warns of layoffs.

choices.text: Take IMF loan specifically for pension stabilization

effects.news: Government borrows to save pensions. Opposition: 'mortgaging our children's future.'

title: Election Commission Accused of Bias
description: Three election commission members have resigned, claiming the chair — appointed by the previous government — is systematically blocking reforms to vote registration that would enfranchise diaspora voters who favor your party.

choices.text: Push for electoral commission reform immediately

effects.news: Government pushes electoral reform. Opposition says it's 'rigging the system in advance.'

choices.text: Negotiate cross-party agreement on new commission

effects.news: Cross-party talks on election commission reform begin. Progress slow but positive.

choices.text: Do nothing — don't provoke opposition on this

effects.news: Election commission controversy fades. International monitors flag ongoing concerns.

title: Record Tourism Season
description: The Western Coast region is experiencing its best tourism season in history. Hotels are full. However, infrastructure cannot cope — beach pollution warnings are rising and locals are complaining about noise and traffic.

choices.text: Invest in coastal infrastructure

effects.news: Government announces coastal infrastructure investment. Tourism industry cheers.

choices.text: Introduce tourism tax to fund local services

effects.news: Tourism levy announced. Hotel owners angry. Revenue to fund local services.

choices.text: Cap tourist numbers for environmental protection

effects.news: Tourism cap shocks industry. GF celebrates. Hotel federation calls it 'economic sabotage.'

title: Major Flooding in Port Region
description: Catastrophic flooding has struck the Port & Trade Zone following a week of unprecedented rainfall. 12,000 people have been evacuated. The port has suspended operations. Damage is estimated at hundreds of millions.

choices.text: Declare national emergency — full state response

effects.news: PM visits flooded region. Government declares emergency. Military deployed. International aid arrives.

choices.text: Coordinate with EU for disaster funding

effects.news: Government requests EU Solidarity Fund. Brussels responds positively. Recovery could take months.

choices.text: Respond locally — no national declaration

effects.news: Government response to flooding called 'inadequate.' Flood victims furious. PM accused of being distant.

title: Constitutional Court Blocks Major Law
description: The Constitutional Court has ruled that your landmark anti-corruption transparency law is unconstitutional, citing privacy concerns. The ruling was 5-4. The dissenting judges published a scathing rebuke suggesting political pressure.

choices.text: Accept ruling — redraft the law with amendments

effects.news: Government accepts court ruling, pledges revised anti-corruption law. Process delayed by months.

choices.text: Attack court publicly — call ruling political

effects.news: PM attacks court ruling as 'politically motivated.' EU sounds alarm. Rule of law monitors activated.

choices.text: Propose constitutional amendment to override the court

effects.news: Government proposes court override amendment. International outrage. Opposition walks out of parliament.

title: Opposition Leader Scandal Emerges
description: Leaked documents appear to show Boyan Tsonev (CU leader) received undeclared payments from a foreign-linked company. The documents came via anonymous source. Your media advisor is excited. Your legal advisor urges caution.

choices.text: Refer to prosecutor — let law take its course

effects.news: Government refers Tsonev documents to prosecutor. Opposition cries political persecution.

choices.text: Use documents in media — maximum political damage

effects.news: Government-linked media runs with Tsonev documents. Source remains anonymous. Authenticity disputed.

choices.text: Do not use — too risky if documents are fake

effects.news: Government declines to comment on leaked opposition documents. Restraint noted by press.

title: Major Foreign Investor Announces Interest
description: A large international manufacturing company is considering building a €200M electric vehicle parts factory in Pustinyakovo that would employ 3,000 workers. They want tax incentives, land grants, and infrastructure guarantees.

choices.text: Accept all demands — full incentive package

effects.news: Landmark EV factory deal signed. 3,000 jobs announced. Opposition calls incentives 'giveaway.'

choices.text: Negotiate harder — reduce tax incentives

effects.news: Modified factory deal agreed after tough negotiations. Fewer incentives, still 2,200 jobs.

choices.text: Reject — concern about environmental impact

effects.news: Government declines factory deal citing environmental concerns. GF cheers. Workers furious.

title: EU Imposes Wine Export Tariff
description: A trade dispute has resulted in the EU imposing a temporary tariff on Pustinyakovo wine exports following allegations of state subsidy violations. The wine sector — key in Southern Fields — faces €80M in losses.

choices.text: Challenge the tariff through EU legal process

effects.news: Government files WTO/EU challenge on wine tariff. Process could take 18 months.

choices.text: Compensate wine producers directly from budget

effects.news: Wine sector bailout announced. Farmers grateful. EU officials annoyed by subsidy.

choices.text: Find alternative export markets in Asia

effects.news: Government launches wine export diversification to Asian markets. Initiative welcomed.

title: Polls Surge — Call Early Election?
description: After a successful crisis response, polls show DA at 38% — highest in years. Your campaign manager says: 'If you call snap elections now, you can win a majority. Wait and the moment will pass.'

choices.text: Call early elections — capitalize on the surge

effects.news: PM dissolves parliament, calls snap election. Gamble on current popularity surge.

choices.text: Stay the course — deliver on your mandate

effects.news: PM rejects early election calls. 'We were elected to govern, not to exploit polls,' says Markova.

title: Port Smuggling Network Exposed
description: Police have uncovered a major smuggling ring operating through the Port & Trade Zone, with alleged links to the port authority and local officials. Three officials have been arrested. The port director has connections to the Citizens' Union.

choices.text: High-profile prosecution — maximum political use

effects.news: Government announces major anti-corruption prosecution. CU denies links to port scandal.

choices.text: Let justice run its course quietly

effects.news: Port smuggling case handed to regular prosecutors. Investigation expected to take months.

choices.text: Use as leverage in coalition negotiations

effects.news: Opposition accuses government of 'selective prosecution' to gain leverage. Prosecutors report pressure.

title: University Students Blockade Campuses
description: Students across the country are blockading universities in protest against proposed education budget cuts and rising tuition fees. The movement is large, organized, and generating significant media attention.

choices.text: Reverse the cuts — full student demands

effects.news: PM reverses education cuts after student protests. Youth surge in polls. IMF 'disappointed.'

choices.text: Meet student representatives — partial compromise

effects.news: Government meets student leaders, agrees partial rollback. Protests continue but peaceful.

choices.text: Ignore — academic year pressure will end protests

effects.news: Government ignores student protests. Movement grows. National Front offers solidarity.

title: GDP Growth Exceeds Expectations
description: Quarterly GDP data shows 4.2% growth — well above the 2.1% forecast. Unemployment has also fallen slightly. Your Finance Minister wants to use this moment strategically.

choices.text: Use surplus to reduce debt

effects.news: Windfall used for debt reduction. Finance Minister praised for prudence. Bond markets rally.

choices.text: Distribute as tax cuts

effects.news: PM announces 'growth dividend' tax reduction. Opposition says it is 'electioneering.'

choices.text: Increase public spending on healthcare and education

effects.news: Growth dividend invested in public services. Coalition united for once.

title: Human Rights Report Critical of Pustinyakovo
description: A major international human rights organization has released a report criticizing prison conditions, police brutality against protesters, and discrimination against the ethnic minority population.

choices.text: Accept report findings — commit to reforms

effects.news: Government accepts human rights criticism, announces reform package. Opposition skeptical.

choices.text: Attack report as politically motivated

effects.news: PM dismisses human rights report as 'foreign interference.' EU Parliament debate scheduled.

choices.text: Acknowledge partial concerns — quiet diplomatic engagement

effects.news: Government meets human rights monitors privately. Limited commitments made.
